messages.en: I've already asked in the group chat, and most of our friends want to come this Saturday.
Great, I'll book a table this afternoon.
The boss lets us choose our own working hours, right?
Yes, but we have to put in eight hours a day. I want to start early.

senses.en_definition: Truth; the actual facts, or the quality of being true.

messages.en: Can we just rehearse in the music room this afternoon?
We need to get the teacher's permission first. I'll ask after class.
Okay, let me know once you've got permission, yeah?
I'm working up the courage to talk to the boss about that schedule.
Just talk it through calmly. I'll come with you if you want.
